literal_meaning: হাত ছোট, আম বড় (hand small, mango big)
figurative_meaning_en: difficulty in grasping or attaining something out of reach
similar_in_english: biting off more than one can chew
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বড় পদ পেতে চায়, কিন্তু হাত ছোট আম বড়।
এই প্রকল্পটা তার জন্য হাত ছোট আম বড়।
example_sentences_in_english: He wants a high position, but it's a case of small hand and big mango.
This project is out of his reach, like a small hand for a big mango.
history: Originated from rural Bengali imagery of farmers or children unable to pluck large mangoes from high branches due to short reach.
note: The idiom uses agricultural metaphor common in Bengali folklore.
